summary: On July 28, 2026, Beeline Holdings, Inc. entered a non-binding LOI with TYTL Holdings, Inc. for an all-stock merger where TYTL would merge into Beeline. The LOI is non-binding except for exclusivity, confidentiality, and termination provisions, with termination fees up to $150,000 or $500,000. Expected ownership split is 60% Beeline stockholders and 40% TYTL holders, subject to negotiation. A special committee was formed due to overlapping CEO/principal shareholder. Final terms await definitive agreements, fairness opinion, and valuation analyses. Watch for definitive agreement execution and regulatory approvals.
